 4-Level Jungle Gap: 'Canyon' Dominates the Rift as Gen.G Takes Game 1 of Semifinals Against IG
 Yeonjae "Arra" Shin 
 arra@inven.co.kr 
 Nov 7, 2026 
 Korean (한국어) 
 KO 
 Add us on 
 ©Riot Games 'Canyon' dominated Summoner's Rift. Driving Gen.G to victory with a destructive performance right from Game 1, he seized the early momentum for his team.
 In Game 1 of the 2026 LoL World Championship (Worlds) semifinals between Gen.G Esports and IG, held at the Credit Union of Texas Event Center in Allen, Texas on the 8th (KST), Gen.G Esports drew first blood by taking Game 1.
 The first battleground was the top lane. As heavy damage trades were exchanged between Kang "TheShy" Seung-lok's Kled and Kim "Kiin" Ki-in's Olaf, both junglers naturally gravitated to the top side. IG, holding the HP advantage, attempted a dive, but Gen.G countered effectively to secure a 2-for-1 kill trade. Kim "Canyon" Geon-bu's Qiyana also pulled off a successful mid gank, quickly jumping to 3/0/0.
 Having broken the game's balance, Gen.G was relentless. They ambushed IG while they were attacking the Voidgrubs to force a teamfight, and after a fierce chase, swept up four kills while giving up only Joo "Duro" Min-kyu's Leona. Fantastic individual aggro juggling shone through. IG tried to target the fed Qiyana, but ended up losing only 'Wei''s Vi, who had engaged with Flash and ultimate.
 Although Jeong "Chovy" Ji-hoon's Cassiopeia was caught in a side lane, Gen.G answered immediately by picking off Kled on the opposite side of the map. Cornered, IG moved even more aggressively. They poured everything into targeting Park "Ruler" Jae-hyuk's Jhin, who lacked Flash and was standing under the mid Tier 2 tower. However, Gen.G's main force was close enough to respond, securing three kills after a chase.
 From there, Gen.G continued to win fight after fight. Before long, the Hextech Soul fell into Gen.G's hands, and the global gold lead neared 10,000. Pressuring with the Baron buff, Gen.G eliminated Song "Rookie" Eui-jin's Syndra through a surprise engage by Qiyana, then pushed forward with their numerical advantage to end the game.
